concept.title: Dashboard
concept.shortdesc: The Dashboard is the home page of the Syndication Service. It gives you an at-a-glance overview of your syncs and recent activity so you can quickly assess the health of your content publishing pipeline.

conbody.p: When you log in to the Syndication Service, the Dashboard is the first page you see. It is organized into two areas: a row of summary tiles at the top and two detail panels below.

section.title: Summary tiles
section.p: The four tiles across the top of the Dashboard give you an immediate count of key metrics:

dlentry.dd: The total number of sync configurations in your organization.
The number of syncs that are currently enabled and will run on their configured schedule.
The number of sync runs surfaced in the Recent Runs panel.
The number of recent runs that ended in a failed or error status. The tile is highlighted when errors are present.

section.title: Syncs panel
section.p: The Syncs panel lists your sync configurations. Each row shows a colored status dot, the sync name, the source and target systems, and the configured schedule. A green dot indicates the sync is active; a grey dot indicates it is inactive.
Click any sync row to open its detail page. Click View all to open the full Syncs list.
section.note: If no syncs have been created yet, the panel shows a prompt with a link to create your first sync.

section.title: Recent Runs panel
section.p: The Recent Runs panel shows the most recent run results across your syncs. Each row displays the run status, the name of the sync that produced it, and the time the run started. When available, it also shows the number of articles changed during that run.
Click View all to open the full Run History page.

section.title: Creating a sync from the Dashboard
section.p: Click New Sync in the upper-right corner of the Dashboard to open the sync creation form.
